Cheng Imm Tan papers

  • English
  • 简体中文
  • 繁體中文

collection

This collection contains audio, videos, pictures, and teaching documents of Gund Kwok, an all-women Asian Lion Dance troupe based in Boston's Chinatown. It also contains some of Cheng Imm Tan's legal and personal documents, such as immigration and travel documents, awards, and family photographs.
